# Welcome to Hamster Simulator – Tiny Paws, Big Adventure VR Game!
 🐹 **Play as a Hamster**

Crawl, explore, and live the tiny hamster life in a playful, interactive world full of surprises and fun adventures.
[media]


 🐹**Chaos Playground**

Unleash wild fun and create total chaos in a playful, interactive world where sandbox mode lets you do anything you imagine.

[media]

 🐹**Fun with Grandpa**

Join Grandpa for playful, interactive games full of surprises, laughter, and fun activities for everyone to enjoy together.

[media]

 🐹**Explore Your Room**

Take a full tour of your room and interact with fun objects all around, discovering hidden surprises and playful secrets everywhere.

[media]

 🐹**Hamster in Messy Kitchen**

Enter a chaotic kitchen playground! Climb towering countertops, sneak through open drawers, explore inside the fridge, and dodge falling utensils. From the sizzling oven to the cluttered dining table, every corner is packed with fun-sized challenges. Experience the kitchen like never before—from a hamster’s tiny, adventurous view!
